newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: INSTANT VIEW-NZ June jobs data closer to RB f'cast.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW-NZ June jobs data closer to RB f'cast.

text.p: After the release of June quarter jobs data by Statistics New Zealand on Tuesday showing a headline unemployment rate of 6.7 percent, commercial bank analysts made the following comments.

Market economists had told Reuters before the data they expected to see an hours worked number significantly lower than a recent Reserve Bank forecast of a seasonally-adjusted rise of 1.9 percent. The out-turn was a 2.5 percent rise.
NICK BENNENBROEK, ECONOMIST, BANKERS TRUST NEW ZEALAND
"The numbers suggest the RB was more or less right and the market was a little further away.
"It's broadly in line with what the RB were expecting, so I think the RB will want to see conditions up towards that 750 level (on the Monetary Conditions Index)."
Bennenbroek said the data basically ruled out any comment by the RBNZ between its set-piece statements unless the markets failed to tighten conditions enough.
"I don't think it rules out an easing in September by the Reserve Bank though, over and above what they've already signalled in June," he added.
